headers.name: YPY-Download
headers.description: Makes the extension fetch the given URL and save it as a download, for backends that cannot stream the file as the YPY response itself.

events.name: ypy:download:start
events.description: Fires on the source element when a download begins streaming. `total` is the `Content-Length`, or `null` when the server sent none.

events.name: ypy:download:progress
events.description: Fires on the source element for every chunk received, for progress bars. `percent` is `null` when the total is unknown.

events.name: ypy:download:complete
events.description: Fires on the source element after the file was handed to the browser as a download.
